does: Resolves a spell's tooltip damage description into the VMDamageRoll collection of the player's UI data.

evidence.says: takes the collection at VMUIData+0x818, the place of the old build's only user of that name string
a count-only probe over 5 s of the host holding Target_MainHandAttack on a goblin shows about 165 calls, one per frame at a 30 fps cap
